title: plugin-auth: review follow-ups of PR #34162 — host-failure docs say removal proceeds, remove-sso-user writes no audit row
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5pmEYLVFDcQ1Z1CS8H

## Problem

PR #34162 (merged as 329f2f79, card #33228) landed while its contract-review record still had an open should-fix: review#2 PASS 6915354714, S1. The record also escalated two items to the dispatching seat. That seat (server#7) is now off duty, so the follow-ups are carried here.

## Owed

1. **S1: docs and logs contradict the door.** When the host fails, the removal door refuses with 503. Three places on main still say the removal goes ahead:
   - the `EnvironmentUserHost` docblock in `environment-user-host.ts`;
   - the `goesAhead('removed')` log line in `environment-user-host.ts`;
   - the `environmentUserHost` option docblock in `auth-plugin.ts`.
   Fix all three to say the removal is refused. Code behaviour is unchanged.
2. **No admin audit row.** `POST /admin/remove-sso-user` removes a pending person without writing an admin audit row. Three dev reports recorded this as "noted, not filed". Add the audit row the other admin user doors write, or record why this door is exempt.
3. **The comment promised on #33187.** Ruling A promised a comment on #33187 that has not been posted. Post it, citing #34162 as the delivery.

## Acceptance

- None of the three places describes a removal going ahead after a host failure.
- A successful `remove-sso-user` writes an admin audit row, pinned by a test, or the exemption is recorded on this card.
- #33187 carries the promised comment.

Clause-②: no. Metadata-protocol: none.
